verdict.rationale: Angular offers optimizations like tree-shaking, AOT compilation and lazy loading that can reduce shipped bundle size (angular-comm-2, angular-gh-6), but Angular positions itself as a 'fully featured platform' with first-party modules for forms, routing, DI, animations, SSR etc. (angular-docs-3, angular-gh-7, angular-gh-9), which runs counter to a 'small, dependency-light' bundle story, and no evidence quantifies bundle size or supply-chain minimalism. missing for 10: concrete bundle-size benchmarks/comparisons, explicit dependency-light architecture claims, independent verification of minimal runtime footprint.
